What they do

About Groove Gear

Groove Gear is a festival lifestyle experience focused on self-expression, creativity and connection. We bring festival fashion, accessories and interactive experiences together, including festival hair, braids, hair tinsel, gems, UV tattoos, temporary body art, face painting, festival accessories, clothing and relaxation experiences.

Our goal is to give people a space to play, express themselves and create a memorable festival moment.
